cohort: The study included 36,603 deliveries in Croatia in 2019, comparing women with induced labor to those with spontaneous onset of labor.
finding: The prevalence of labor induction in Croatia was 14.1%, and it was associated with specific maternal risk factors and adverse perinatal outcomes including higher rates of cesarean section, vacuum extraction, postpartum hemorrhage, and shoulder dystocia.
mod_finding: Induced labor was associated with a higher incidence of cesarean section and vacuum extraction, outcomes directly related to the mode of birth.
